title: Department of Defense Handbook: Metallic Materials and Elements for Aerospace Vehicle Structures (MIL-HDBK-5J)
publisher: U.S. Department of Defense (with the Federal Aviation Administration)

reuse.statement_in_document: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A. Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.
reuse.basis: U.S. Government work (17 U.S.C. 105) with Distribution Statement A.

files.note: download with the URL above; verify the checksum
text layer of every page that holds a design-properties table, extracted with pypdf 6.19.0 (PdfReader.extract_text); regenerate with `python -m domains.uav_materials.ingest.build --from-pdf`

used: Room-temperature design allowables from 'Design Mechanical and Physical Properties' tables: Ftu, Fty, Fcy, Fsu, elongation, E, G, density. Original units ksi, percent, 10^3 ksi, lb/in^3.
not_used: Bearing allowables; tables the strict parser cannot read unambiguously (row-major letter-spaced layout, one alloy per column, token-count mismatches; see processed/build_report.json); all figures (elevated-temperature curves, fatigue, stress-strain).
caveats: MIL-HDBK-5J is superseded by MMPDS; values are historical design allowables, not current certification data. Allowables are statistically based (A, B) or specification minima (S).
